name: brief-agents
description: 📝 Subagents inherit none of your durable rules — not your CLAUDE.md, memory or plugin nudges. brief-agents scans all three into one compact ~/.claude/agent-briefing-index.md, regenerated when the sources change. A SessionStart hook nudges you to brief subagents, and a PreToolUse hook blocks unbriefed Agent/Task code delegations (Workflow gets a soft reminder; [no-brief] opts out; forks exempt).
